title: Completed LESSONS LEARNED SUMMARY Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed LESSONS LEARNED SUMMARY artifact data payloads (PMO-07.01).

requirements_definition_and_management_w.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in defining and managing requirements. Name the practice, not the meeting where it was discussed.
Practices or incidents that can be improved in defining and managing requirements, and what the improvement should be.

scope_definition_and_management_what_wor.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in defining and managing scope. Where baselines were held, say so.

scope_definition_and_management_what_can.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in defining and managing scope.

schedule_development_and_control_what_wo.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in developing and controlling the schedule.

schedule_development_and_control_what_ca.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in developing and controlling the schedule.

cost_estimating_and_control_what_worked_.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in developing estimates and controlling costs.

cost_estimating_and_control_what_can_be_.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in developing estimates and controlling costs.

quality_planning_and_control_what_worked.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in planning, managing, and controlling quality.

quality_planning_and_control_what_can_be.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in planning, managing, and controlling quality. Specific defects are recorded in the quality defects section below.

physical_resource_planning_and_control_w.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in planning, acquiring, and managing physical resources.
Practices or incidents that can be improved in planning, acquiring, and managing physical resources.

team_planning_development_and_performanc.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in working with team members and developing and managing the team.
Practices or incidents that can be improved in working with team members and developing and managing the team.

communications_management_what_worked_we.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in planning and distributing information.

communications_management_what_can_be_im.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in planning and distributing information.

reporting_what_worked_well.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in reporting project performance.

reporting_what_can_be_improved.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in reporting project performance.

risk_management_what_worked_well.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in the risk management process. Specific risks are recorded in the risks and issues section below.

risk_management_what_can_be_improved.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in the risk management process. Specific risks are recorded in the risks and issues section below.

procurement_planning_and_management_what.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in planning, conducting, and administering contracts.
Practices or incidents that can be improved in planning, conducting, and administering contracts.

stakeholder_engagement_what_worked_well.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in engaging stakeholders.

stakeholder_engagement_what_can_be_impro.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in engaging stakeholders.

process_improvement_information_what_wor.description: Processes that were developed and should be continued on future projects.

process_improvement_information_what_can.description: Processes that should be changed or discontinued.

product_specific_information_what_worked.description: Practices or incidents that were effective in delivering the specific product, service, or result.

product_specific_information_what_can_be.description: Practices or incidents that can be improved in delivering the specific product, service, or result.

other_what_worked_well.description: Other practices or incidents that were effective, such as change control, configuration management, or integration management.

other_what_can_be_improved.description: Other practices or incidents that can be improved, such as change control, configuration management, or integration management.

risk_or_issue.description: Describe the risk or issue that occurred and should be considered to improve organizational learning.

response.description: Describe the response that was taken and its effectiveness. Say plainly whether the response worked.

comments.description: Provide any additional information needed to improve future project performance.

defect.description: Describe the quality defect that should be considered to improve organizational effectiveness.

resolution.description: Describe how the defect was resolved and whether the resolution held.

comments.description: Indicate what should be done to improve future project performance.

vendor.description: List the vendor or vendors concerned.

issue.description: Describe any issues, claims, or disputes that occurred with this vendor.

resolution.description: Describe the outcome or resolution that was reached.

comments.description: Indicate what should be done to improve future vendor management performance.

entry.description: Identify areas of exceptional performance that can be passed on to other teams. State what was done and what made it work.
Identify areas that can be improved for future performance. State the improvement sought, not only the problem.
